items.statement: The investigation explicitly preserves the supplied benzene, hydronium, mono-hydrate and dihydrate identities and charge/multiplicity assignments, and reports per-object validation.
items.expected: Per-object identities, n=0/1/2 labels, charge and multiplicity are retained and checked.

items.statement: At least the advanced minima and pathway stationary points are validated by frequency/pathway evidence rather than energies alone.
items.expected: Minimum checks and TS/pathway checks are reported per candidate; unvalidated objects are marked as such.

items.statement: Bare hydronium proton transfer to benzene is thermodynamically favorable and can approach collision/association-limit behavior.
items.expected: The report identifies bare-hydronium PT as the least hindered/high-turnover reference case within its stated model.

items.statement: Hydrated hydronium introduces ligand-switching/adduct pathways and can slow conversion through stable complexes and internal barriers.
items.expected: The report distinguishes hydrated pathways from bare PT and attributes reduced turnover to complex/barrier effects, with limitations.
